name: mitti-exporter
description: Let Claude sync and query your exported Mitti Exporter data — inspections, actions, issues, schedules — and build reports. Local-first: your API token stays in the exporter's own config, never in Claude's.
long_description:
Mitti Exporter runs as a local MCP server over stdio.

What Claude can do once connected:
- Sync your latest data locally (incremental or full)
- Answer questions with read-only SQL over your inspections, inspection items, templates, sites, users, actions, issues, schedules, assets and more
- Generate PDF/Word inspection reports with in-chat download buttons
- Show inspection photos inline
- Render query results as interactive tables (MCP Apps / SEP-1865)

Setup: install the Mitti Exporter desktop app or CLI first and configure your API token there (the token is read from the exporter's own config file — it is never stored in Claude's config).

All queries are read-only: the database is opened read-only and only single SELECT statements are accepted.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in the local export database

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Show a table's schema plus sample rows

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run read-only SQL against the local export database

tools.name: sync_data
tools.description: Sync the latest Mitti Exporter data locally
